name: Analytics Brain
description:
Analytics Brain connects your assistant to Witbee's knowledge base on marketing analytics, tracking and data engineering — webinar write-ups, newsletter issues, procedures and guides written by Witbee's own team.

Once connected, your assistant searches the library and reads documents in full while it answers, then cites what it used — so you get answers grounded in Witbee's actual published material instead of whatever the model happens to remember, and you can go check the source yourself.

Key features:
• Full-text search across every document's title and body
• Read any document in full, with its place in the folder structure for context
• Results are scoped to your own account's access — nothing you can't already see on the platform is exposed to the assistant, and nothing outside it is either

_published_faq.name: How do I add Analytics Brain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Analytics Brain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.brain.witbee.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Analytics Brain MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Analytics Brain provides these MCP tools: list_documents, read_document, and search_documents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Analytics Brain?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Analytics Brain in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.

_published_faq.name: Does Analytics Brain MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Analytics Brain requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Analytics Brain is developed by Witbee. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
